title: Escalation Handoff: Summary vs Full Transcript

steps.prompt: An Agentforce service agent escalates chats to human agents through Omni-Channel when a customer expresses frustration. Escalated chats average 30 turns before transfer, each human agent handles three chats at once, and post-chat surveys show customers re-explaining their issue after transfer. What should the handoff give the human agent?

options.label: A work item carrying a generated summary of the issue, intent, and steps tried
options.rationale: Escalation should carry the conversation's context so the customer never repeats what the AI agent already collected. Someone juggling three chats cannot read 30 turns before replying, so condensed context is what lets them pick up without re-asking.

options.label: A work item linking the full 30-turn transcript for the human agent to review
options.rationale: Thirty turns take minutes to read for an agent already on two other chats, so they re-ask the customer instead, which is what the surveys show.

options.label: A recap the customer writes when the AI agent asks for one just before transfer
options.rationale: Asking a frustrated customer to restate the issue repeats information the AI agent already holds, which is the repetition the surveys complain about.
